## Domain analysis and decisions

### Business decisions and use cases (`decisions`)

Derive questions, priorities, and metrics from user decisions.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Metric contract (`metric_contract`)

Fix definition, numerator, denominator, grain, time, exclusions, and approval.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Source profile and semantic conflicts (`source_profile`)

Profile sources and record conflicting definitions and adjudication.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Fact grain and conformed dimensions (`fact_grain`)

Define fact-row meaning, dimension conformance, and master-data dependencies.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### History and restatement policy (`history`)

Define late-arriving data, historical versions, comparisons, and restatement gates.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Load reconciliation and rejects (`loading`)

Compare source and target totals, rejects, duplicates, and latency with repair ownership.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Reporting and business acceptance (`business_acceptance`)

Accept with real decision scenarios, permissions, and critical metrics.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Release support and adoption (`operations`)

Plan release, rollback, SLA, support, and usage-outcome monitoring.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.
